name: Ahmad Shaharuddin
bio:
Ahmad developed a keen interest in motorsport while helping his father, a mechanic, repair motorcycles. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in quality assurance. After graduating, he joined Proton, initially working on road cars, but quickly transitioned to their motorsport division, where he honed his skills in optimizing vehicle performance and reliability. 

Ahmad's meticulous nature and relentless pursuit of perfection make him an ideal quality control expert. He believes in a data-driven approach, meticulously analyzing every component and process to identify potential weaknesses. His focus on innovation allows him to creatively solve problems and implement solutions that enhance the overall performance and durability of the rallycross cars. He joined Hansen World RX Team seeking to contribute to a world-class racing environment.

What distinguishes Ahmad is his ability to balance rigorous quality standards with practical considerations. He understands the pressures of a race weekend and strives to find solutions that are both effective and implementable under tight deadlines, ensuring the team can perform at its best when it matters most.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed hair with a slight fade on the sides
physical.description: Ahmad has a focused look about him, his build suggesting a life spent both wrenching and analyzing.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously recording observations.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on surfaces when deep in thought.
Insists on using his own specialized set of measuring tools, regardless of what's available.
